_readme: machines.json — hostname → logical-name map + tailscale second factor (per the
2026-07-30 flight handoff §5 step 3). Keyed by `hostname -s` output, which is what
deploy.sh resolves through. The tailscale node id is a verification factor, not a
lookup key: a script MAY check `tailscale status --json | .Self.ID` against it
before trusting the logical identity (kills hostname-spoof and wrong-machine cases).
Add a machine = add a row. Never key on IP; IPs are here as convenience data only.
